doc.title: Warren Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 23, 1995

chapter: Life on the road and advice
title: Dream band and singers he accompanied
summary: No single dream band; he has backed Rosemary Clooney and recorded with Bobby Short and on a Benny Carter songbook album.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Wow. Who are the guys — who is your dream band? Can you tell me about that?
Just too many, yeah. I just love so many people.
Have you worked behind some notable singers over the years?

Well, Rosemary Clooney. Scott and I did Rosemary Clooney for a number of years. I just did a record with Bobby Short, and a double album with Benny Carter that is “The Benny Carter Songbook” and has oh I would think anywhere from twelve to thirteen singers on it. Everyone did two or three tracks apiece or one track apiece. Everybody from Shirley Horn to Joe Williams.
